Elke verlofsoort heeft eigen regels. Hum: Every leave type has its own rules. Humaniq applies them when a request is submitted: whether the type draws from a balance, whether a reason or a document is required, and how many days in advance the request must be in. A type that no longer applies is switched off; old requests keep their type.
